设备控制只管理本后台启动的进程，不接管外部启动的进程。正在进行的追踪器初始化或离: Device control only manages processes started by this backend; it does not take over externally started processes. Cancel any active Tracker setup or offline computation and wait for it to exit first.
“设备”中的标定与离线工具入口，可打开追踪器初始化、相机–追踪器标定以及离线检查: Calibration and offline tool entries on Devices open Tracker initialization, camera–Tracker calibration, offline checks, and time alignment.
相机–追踪器标定嵌入主程序，支持引导采集与离线求解；关闭工作台不停止后台标定任务: Camera–Tracker calibration is embedded in the main window, with guided capture and offline solving. Closing the workbench does not stop backend calibration jobs. The original glove calibration window still owns its hand-pose solver; closing it may stop that hand's pose acquisition.
